en.title: 7 Must-See Shows Wrapping Up in 2027: Prepare for the Feels
en.summary: As 2027 approaches, we're bracing for the finales of some of our favorite series. This list highlights the must-watch shows ending their runs, offering a chance to catch up or revisit beloved stories.
en.body:
## 1. Emily in Paris (Netflix)
Get ready to say 'au revoir' to Emily Cooper's Parisian adventures. The sixth season of this vibrant dramedy will be its last, promising a final, unforgettable chapter for the social media savvy marketing exec navigating love, career, and croissants in the City of Lights. Expect the signature blend of fashion, romance, and cultural mishaps that has made it a global phenomenon.

## 2. The Morning Show (Apple TV+)
We'll be tuning out of the high-stakes world of broadcast journalism as The Morning Show prepares for its conclusion. This drama, lauded for its sharp writing and stellar performances, has tackled complex issues with nuance. Its final season will undoubtedly offer a compelling send-off to its ensemble cast, leaving us pondering the future of media and the personal lives of its anchors.

## 3. The Empress (Netflix)
Step back into 19th-century Austria for one last time with the German historical drama, The Empress. Season three is set to be the final installment, closing the book on Empress Elisabeth's tumultuous reign and personal life. If you're a fan of lavish period pieces with a dramatic flair, this is your chance to witness the culmination of Sisi's story.

## 4. From (MGM+)
The chilling mystery of From is set to unravel completely in 2027. This sci-fi horror series, which traps residents in a nightmarish town where horrific creatures emerge at night, is confirmed to end with its upcoming season. If you've been on the edge of your seat wondering about the town's secrets and how to escape, the final episodes will deliver the answers.

## 5. Embassy (MGM+)
This limited series is poised to make its debut and conclude within 2027. While details are scarce, its classification as a limited series means it's designed for a singular, impactful narrative arc. Keep an eye on Embassy for a contained, potentially gripping story that you can experience from start to finish within the year.

## 6. Silo (Apple TV+)
While not explicitly stated as ending in 2027, the fourth season of Silo is confirmed and will be its last. This dystopian sci-fi hit, set in a massive underground silo housing the last remnants of humanity, has captivated audiences with its intricate world-building and suspense. The upcoming season will bring the mysteries of the silo and its inhabitants to a definitive close.

## 7. The Last of Us (HBO)
Prepare for a somber farewell to Joel and Ellie's harrowing journey. While the series has been renewed for a third season, it has been confirmed by co-creator Craig Mazin that the story is planned to conclude with this upcoming installment. This adaptation of the beloved video game has been a critical darling, and its final season will undoubtedly be an emotional, must-watch event.

Bottom Line: 2027 is shaping up to be a year of epic finales, so grab your popcorn and prepare for some tearful goodbyes.

content_raw: When the calendar turns to 2027, TV fans will have to say goodbye to an eclectic group of shows that rank among the medium's best in recent years.
